title: Gnashing Killer Shark and companions
summary: A shaman quest summons a dangerous shark and two companions beneath Cobalt Scar.
overview: A shaman quest summons a dangerous shark and two companions beneath Cobalt Scar.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Have underwater travel and combat preparations ready before speaking with Yoppa.
The eligible shaman starts the encounter through the quest dialogue.
Collect all three sharks and focus the group on one target at a time.
